title: Rarest-Items Spotlight
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), vinyl plays (`vinyl:play`), LEGO sets (`lego:set`), trading-card prices (`tradingcard:price`).
app: Collection catalogues and price APIs — Discogs (vinyl), BrickLink (LEGO), trading-card and coin/stamp price feeds, and personal inventory databases with NFC-tagged scans — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:item
| stats latest(rarity_score) as rarity, latest(market_value) as value by item
| sort - rarity
| head 15
description: Spotlights the rarest pieces in your collection by a rarity score, the crown jewels worth showing off.
value: A rarity ranking celebrates the highlights of a collection and reminds you which pieces deserve the best care.
implementation: Ingest rarity scores into `index=personal`; surface the rarest items.
visualization: Ranked table of the rarest items with value.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights the rarest pieces in your collection, the special ones worth showing off and protecting.
